answer: The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 5 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. Because the delta hash is checked against the knoll checkpoint at intake, the reef audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs hence has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator forfeits authoring per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
